title: Orientation
description: horizontal: a strip, rank beside name, pp and avatar. vertical: a stacked card (avatar, name, rank, pp). auto picks whichever fits the page size larger (a wide page gets the strip). The tag scales to the page.

title: Alignment
description: Side of the page the tag hugs. right puts the avatar on the outer right edge (for the right side of the screen); left mirrors it.

title: Motion
description: full = the tag eases in and out with gameplay; after a results screen rank and pp count to their new values and the session change slides in; a rank gain draws an amber rule under the rank. reduced = the same without the rule. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Show avatar
description: Your profile picture from a.ppy.sh (or the custom avatar below); your initial stands in when it cannot load. Off hides the avatar and makes no outside request. In a narrow box the avatar gives way before the numbers do.

title: Show session changes
description: Beside rank and pp: the change since this source loaded (▲ rank places gained, ▼ lost, ±0 before anything changed; your gains in amber), kept per account and ruleset. Live values only. Reload the source to start a new session.

title: Custom username
description: Shown instead of the live username when not empty. Any custom value makes the tag show during gameplay even without a signed-in profile (the replay renderer keeps the profile idle).

title: Custom avatar
description: Image URL or data: URI (e.g. data:image/png;base64,…) shown instead of your a.ppy.sh picture when not empty. The replay renderer blocks every outside URL, a.ppy.sh included: use a data: URI there, or leave it empty for the initial.

title: Custom global rank
description: Shown instead of the live rank when not empty. A number (#4,120 or 4120) is formatted; other text is shown as typed.

title: Custom pp
description: Shown instead of the live pp when not empty. A number is formatted; other text is shown as typed.

title: Custom country
description: Country code (e.g. US) shown instead of the live one when not empty.
